thread:
marta: Starting a focused compare run: FP8 vs AWQ on the private node pool (priv-eu-2). Objective: decide safe traffic rules + fallback gates for staged migration. Kicking off perf + quality evals now.

ajay: Which eval sets and pass/fail criteria?

marta: convqa-small for QA EM, summarizer-regression for ROUGE-L. Baseline = fp16. Pass if EM drop <= 1.0% and ROUGE-L drop <= 1.5%. Also require p95 latency not > +15% vs baseline.

kai: Got it. Running AWQ-int8 and FP8-8bit variants with same prompt traces. Will run 10k tokens per model, include seq_len stratified (<=256, 257-512, 513-1024). ETA ~40m.

deploy-bot: :gear: Deployment started: job/quant-compare-1782109876 -> priv-eu-2 (AWQ, FP8)

sarah: For rollout plan I want: hosted: 1% traffic limit, dedicated: 5% -> 25% after pass, private: 0% until explicit green. Private stays strict because of compliance.

marta: Agreed. Gate rules: if convqa EM drop > 1.5% OR ROUGE-L drop > 2% OR p95 latency increase > 15% => immediate fallback to fp16. OOMs or increased error rate also trigger fallback. Add routing rule for long sequences if needed.

ajay: Drafting the safety gates + rollout config now. Pushing quick YAML snippet for visibility:

```
rollout:
  hosted: {percent: 1}
  dedicated: {percent: 5}
  private: {percent: 0}

gates:
  - name: convqa_em
    max_drop_pct: 1.5
    action: fallback_fp16
  - name: rouge_l
    max_drop_pct: 2.0
    action: fallback_fp16
  - name: p95_latency
    max_increase_pct: 15
    action: fallback_fp16
rules:
  - if: seq_len > 512
    route: fp16
  - if: oom_rate > 0
    route: fp16
```

kai: Early numbers from first batch (AWQ): convqa EM -1.9%, ROUGE-L -0.8%, p95 latency +18% on seq_len 768 traces. :thinking_face:

marta: That's outside convqa threshold (1.5%). That fails the gate. Kai, please stop the AWQ job and capture traces.

kai: Stopped. Collecting traces and perf flamegraphs now. Quick observation: AWQ kernels regressed on seq_len around 700-900; seems chunking not applied by default on that build.

sarah: OK fail makes sense. Action items: 1) try AWQ with chunked kernels + quantized KV cache; 2) add a route rule to send seq_len>512 to fp16 or FP8 fallback variant; 3) automated rollback window 5m.

marta: Add to ticket INF-1234. Also let's add a soft-margin for convqa: if EM drop is between 1.0% and 1.5% we mark as 'investigate' but don't auto-fail; if >1.5% auto-fail.

ajay: Updating infra to support seq_len routing and rollout gates. Will open a PR with the config change and enable test traffic to dedicated pool only. ETA PR in 10m.

kai: Will re-run AWQ with chunked kernel + KV quantization and a short warmup. ETA ~30m. Will post metrics.

marta: Thanks. Once Kai posts the next run, we'll re-evaluate. If AWQ still regresses on convqa we'll consider promoting FP8 with tighter quant profiles as our near-term migration path for private nodes.

sarah: Note for ops: please keep dedicated monitoring dashboard pinned. Create an alert if any gate flips to fail during a live migration. :rotating_light:

marta: Copy. Logging this thread to INF-1234 and will include the YAML gates + early AWQ failure note.

deploy-bot: Job/quant-compare-1782109876 stopped by kai at 1782109999: reason=manual-stop (failed-convqa-gate)

marta: Closing loop. We'll reconvene after the next run. Thanks all. :v:
